Given that the line integral

$$
{∮}_{C}F\cdot \text{d}r
$$

 
represents the area of the region $D$ enclosed by any such curve in ${R}^{2},$ which of the following could be the vector field $F(x,y)?$

I. $F(x,y)=⟨\frac{y}{8} + 3 e^{3 x + y},\,\frac{9 x}{8} + e^{3 x + y}⟩$

II. $F(x,y)=⟨2 y^{3} - \frac{y}{8},\,6 x y^{2} + \frac{7 x}{8}⟩$

III. $F(x,y)=⟨2 y e^{3 x},\,x - 2 e^{3 x}⟩$" :question/worked-solution "According to Green's theorem, if $F(x,y)=⟨P(x,y),\,Q(x,y)⟩,$ where

$$
\frac{∂Q}{∂x}-\frac{∂P}{∂y}=1,
$$

we can write the area of the region $D$ enclosed by the curve $C$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{Area}(D) & ={∬}_{D}\text{d}A \\  & ={∬}_{D}(\frac{∂Q}{∂x}-\frac{∂P}{∂y})\text{d}A \\  & ={∮}_{C}P\,\text{d}x+Q\,\text{d}y \\  & ={∮}_{C}F\cdot \text{d}r\end{aligned}
$$

  

With that in mind, let's examine each pair in turn.

- Vector field I gives the required area. In this case,
$\frac{∂P}{∂y}=3 e^{3 x + y} + \frac{1}{8}$
and
$\frac{∂Q}{∂x}=3 e^{3 x + y} + \frac{9}{8},$
which gives

$$
\frac{∂Q}{∂x}-\frac{∂P}{∂y}=\left(3 e^{3 x + y} + \frac{9}{8}\right)-\left(3 e^{3 x + y} + \frac{1}{8}\right)=\left(\frac{9}{8}\right)+\left(3 e^{3 x + y}\right)-\left(\frac{1}{8}\right)-\left(3 e^{3 x + y}\right)=1.
$$

- Vector field II gives the required area. Notice that
$\frac{∂P}{∂y}=6 y^{2} - \frac{1}{8}$
and
$\frac{∂Q}{∂x}=6 y^{2} + \frac{7}{8},$
which gives

$$
\frac{∂Q}{∂x}-\frac{∂P}{∂y}=\left(6 y^{2} + \frac{7}{8}\right)-\left(6 y^{2} - \frac{1}{8}\right)=\left(\frac{7}{8}\right)+\left(6 y^{2}\right)-\left(- \frac{1}{8}\right)-\left(6 y^{2}\right)=1.
$$

- Vector field III does *not* give the required area. Notice that
$\frac{∂P}{∂y}=2 e^{3 x}$
and
$\frac{∂Q}{∂x}=1 - 6 e^{3 x},$
which gives

$$
\frac{∂Q}{∂x}-\frac{∂P}{∂y}=\left(1 - 6 e^{3 x}\right)-\left(2 e^{3 x}\right)=\left(1\right)+\left(- 6 e^{3 x}\right)-\left(2 e^{3 x}\right)=1 - 8 e^{3 x}\ne 1.
$$

Therefore, the correct answer is "I and II only."" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/hard :question/answer-fields ["c25cca0a-b7a7-507b-9856-376103dd2619"] :db/ensure :question/validate} {:db/id "cd5c80ef-250f-585d-9d97-aaa338143d40" :answer/id #uuid "cd5c80ef-250f-585d-9d97-aaa338143d40" :answer/type :answer.type/text :answer/value "I only" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "b363201f-18dc-5e51-acfc-f06f7460564c" :answer/id #uuid "b363201f-18dc-5e51-acfc-f06f7460564c" :answer/type :answer.type/text :answer/value "I and III only" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "0b1e8dee-c49e-5763-949a-f2bffd9d1260" :answer/id #uuid "0b1e8dee-c49e-5763-949a-f2bffd9d1260" :answer/type :answer.type/text :answer/value "I, II, and III" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "35e79054-058f-5a00-9694-56f64a66fe01" :answer/id #uuid "35e79054-058f-5a00-9694-56f64a66fe01" :answer/type :answer.type/text :answer/value "II only" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "097b0bc3-3ff7-5783-9b57-cb381a5f6300" :answer/id #uuid "097b0bc3-3ff7-5783-9b57-cb381a5f6300" :answer/type :answer.type/text :answer/value "III only" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "0bde310c-c096-553c-942f-54191251cf4a" :answer-field/id #uuid "0bde310c-c096-553c-942f-54191251cf4a" :answer-field/key "selection" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/radio :answer-field/choices ["cd5c80ef-250f-585d-9d97-aaa338143d40" "b363201f-18dc-5e51-acfc-f06f7460564c" "0b1e8dee-c49e-5763-949a-f2bffd9d1260" "35e79054-058f-5a00-9694-56f64a66fe01" "097b0bc3-3ff7-5783-9b57-cb381a5f6300"] :answer-field/correct "b363201f-18dc-5e51-acfc-f06f7460564c" :db/ensure :answer-field/validate} {:db/id "11c0c73c-d02d-532a-b38b-0bdd208cbe12" :question/id #uuid "11c0c73c-d02d-532a-b38b-0bdd208cbe12" :question/problem "Let $C$ be a simple, piecewise-smooth, closed, and positively oriented curve.
